scope: Temporary fork-only capture specification gate. Intentional baseline failures prove regression discrimination, not implementation success.

R1.statement: Matching input-suspension resume restores the prior aggregate state and each present output stream started state.

review_proof.criteria: Review that the existing single-depth snapshot records aggregate state before suspension and restores it once with independent output flags.

R2.statement: Ordinary resume retains input restoration, repeated matched cycles, missing streams, and output capture resumption.

review_proof.criteria: Review the no-snapshot path and preserved capture APIs; run the affected capture, debugging, and logging suites.

R3.statement: Low-level capture states are exactly initialized, started, suspended, done, or None. Aggregate states are exactly started, suspended, stopped, or None.

review_proof.criteria: Inspect Literal declarations and snapshot payload against both exact state domains; confirm NoCapture remains stateless and repository type checks pass. This baseline gate does not certify the future type change.

R4.statement: The written specification and ordinary acceptance assertions precede production changes, with hosted specification validation passing first.

review_proof.owner: specification validation job and implementation reviewer
review_proof.stage: hosted specification commit before production implementation
review_proof.criteria: Verify the fixed original base/source tree, accepted test hash, exact collection and baseline outcomes; retain this commit and hosted run receipt before production changes.

R5.statement: Accepted tests remain unchanged during implementation; specification commit/run receipts and content hashes establish chronology.

review_proof.stage: specification receipt and final implementation head
review_proof.criteria: Retain the gate receipt containing commit, run URL, original production source tree, and SHA256 hashes; compare accepted test content with that receipt on the final head.

R7.statement: Keep personal plans, review records, organization data, and logs outside public commits; these specification helpers are temporary and fork-only.

review_proof.stage: specification commit and final contribution head
review_proof.criteria: Audit public text and paths; verify only the four allowed specification files changed at this stage, keep generated evidence outside the checkout, and remove temporary contract/workflow/validator files from the final contribution diff.

R9.statement: Preserve the existing matched-pair, single-depth suspension contract without arbitrary-depth capture management.

review_proof.criteria: Inspect the snapshot lifecycle for one matching resume and verify no stack, depth counter, or expanded capture API is introduced; confirm the paired-cycle and snapshot-consumption controls pass.

AE1.statement: For sys and fd, an input-only nested suspension restores suspended aggregate and output states; a following disabled-capture context leaves stdout and stderr outside capture buffers.

AE2.statement: With the actual live logging plugin enabled, a warning and following stdout/stderr writes leave the previously suspended capture buffers empty and aggregate state suspended.

AE3.statement: Two matched input suspend/resume pairs restore the captured stdin object and active aggregate/output states; stdout and stderr are captured after each pair.

AE4.statement: Independent output started states are preserved for every combination; absent stdout, stderr, both outputs, and stdin retain the existing restoration/no-snapshot behavior.

AE5.statement: A consumed input suspension snapshot does not affect a later ordinary suspend/resume, which starts output capture and records stdout/stderr.
